title: 2018 Software Engineering Exit Exam (Predicted)
source: Pattern-based prediction from 2015–2017 exams + MoEE blueprint / Exit Notes

focusGuide.Fundamentals of Programming: Loops, operators, debugging, paradigms, and basic programming concepts.
focusGuide.C++: Syntax, loops, identifiers, headers, and memory operators.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Stacks, queues, trees, graphs, BFS/DFS, hash tables, and Big-O reasoning.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Inheritance, interfaces, encapsulation, polymorphism, and Java keywords.
focusGuide.Web Development: HTML/CSS/JS, HTTP methods, status codes, AJAX, and HTTPS.
focusGuide.Android: Activity, Intent, Manifest, ViewGroup, and APK components.
focusGuide.Database: Keys, normalization, SQL, ER mapping, and ACID properties.
focusGuide.Operating Systems: Process states, deadlock, scheduling, paging, and virtual memory.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: SDLC, requirements, refactoring, code smells, maintenance, and coupling.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Microservices, API gateway, quality attributes, and design patterns.
focusGuide.Project Management: WBS, Gantt, critical path, agile values, and Tuckman stages.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Test levels, V&V, black/white box, equivalence partitioning, regression.
focusGuide.Networking: OSI layers, TCP/UDP, topologies, DNS, switches vs routers.
focusGuide.Security: CIA triad, AES, XSS, firewalls, MFA, malware, and hashing.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Supervised vs unsupervised, A*/BFS/UCS, agents, K-means, decision trees.

questions.text: Which of the following is a valid C++ identifier?
questions.concept: Key idea (Fundamentals of Programming): Valid identifiers start with letter or underscore

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a breakpoint in debugging?

options.text: To mark the start of a loop
To pause program execution at a chosen line

questions.concept: Key idea (Fundamentals of Programming): Breakpoint pauses execution for inspection

questions.text: Which programming paradigm focuses on step-by-step instructions and mutable state?
questions.concept: Key idea (Fundamentals of Programming): Procedural paradigm

questions.text: A compiler differs from an interpreter because a compiler:

options.text: Executes code line by line at runtime
Translates the entire program before execution
Only checks syntax without producing output

questions.text: Which type of error is detected by the compiler before the program runs?
questions.concept: Key idea (Fundamentals of Programming): Syntax errors caught at compile time

questions.text: What is the output of: for(int i=0; i<3; i++) cout << i;

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a valid C++ variable name?
questions.concept: Key idea (C++): Identifiers cannot start with a digit
